_comment: Seed case studies for /work. This file is the SHIPPED baseline only — at runtime the admin at /admin overlays a locally-edited copy (localStorage, key delai.projects.v3) so the portfolio can be managed without a deploy. When the portfolio moves to a real store (POST /api/portfolio/drafts), this file becomes the fallback the store is seeded from. `approach` is newline-delimited: one bullet per line.

projects.title: PAGE
projects.summary: A phone-first payment experience for microbusinesses. One link to view, pay, and confirm — no account, no app, no invoice software.
projects.challenge: Microbusinesses get paid badly. Invoicing tools assume an accounting workflow that a two-person operation does not have, and the alternative is a screenshot of a payment app and a lot of trust. Money arrives late, reconciliation is manual, and nobody knows what's outstanding.
projects.approach:
A single shareable link as the entire product surface
Mobile-first flow that works for a customer who has never seen it before
Automatic confirmation and record-keeping on both sides
Built to drop into an existing conversation — text, DM, email
projects.result: A working product in market that removes the invoicing step entirely for small operators. Payment requests go out inside the conversation where the work was agreed, and the record keeps itself.

projects.title: Alba
projects.summary: A personal learning system that turns raw information into guided sessions, retained knowledge, and material you can use again.
projects.challenge: People collect information constantly and retain almost none of it. Note apps store things; they don't teach. The gap is between having material and actually knowing it — and no amount of better folders closes that gap.
projects.approach:
AI that turns source material into structured, guided sessions
A memory model that tracks what has actually been retained
Reusable knowledge objects instead of dead notes
A daily loop short enough to survive a real schedule
projects.result: A learning application where the AI does the instructional design — converting what you bring it into sessions, checks, and durable knowledge rather than another archive you never reopen.

projects.title: EyeGoal
projects.summary: An operating platform for optical practices and labs that connects patient intake, point of sale, inventory, prescriptions, billing, lab workflows, and daily operations.
projects.challenge: An optical practice runs on half a dozen systems that don't speak: an intake form, a register, an inventory sheet, the lab's order portal, a billing tool, and paper. The same prescription gets retyped four times, nobody can say which stage a job is at, and the end of day is a person with a calculator.
projects.approach:
Patient intake and prescriptions captured once, then reused everywhere downstream
Point of sale, inventory, and billing on one connected record per patient
Lab workflow tracking, so every job has a visible stage and an owner
Daily operations and reconciliation generated by the system instead of assembled by hand
projects.result: One platform where the practice and the lab are looking at the same job at the same stage. Prescriptions stop being retyped, inventory reflects what actually sold, and closing the day is a report rather than an evening.
